scope: Research-only final gap check for current Shakespeare Tiger spinning reels; no production edits or publishing.
null_meaning: No trustworthy exact-model specification verified; not zero or not applicable.

evidence.finding: All five exact models appear in the comparison table. No reel-weight or recovery-rate specification. Embedded variant specifications have an empty Max Drag (lbs) value for every model; visible selected-model pages show a dash placeholder.
Exact model comparison lists size, ratio, retrieve hand, bearing count and mono capacity, but none of the three requested fields.

evidence.title: 2026 Shakespeare - North America
evidence.verification_method: Opened from Pure Fishing's catalog bookshelf; searched TIGRSP and visually inspected enlarged page 47 in the browser. The URL displays the 46-47 spread.
evidence.finding: Tiger Spinning Reel table explicitly lists TIGRSP30/40/50/60/80 with material numbers 1645661-1645665. Columns are Model #, Material, Packaging, Size, Capacity, Gear Ratio, Bearing, Handle and Pre-Spooled Line. No reel weight, maximum drag or inches-per-turn column or accompanying claim.

evidence.verification_method: Visually inspected all five manufacturer package-front images in browser.
evidence.finding: No visible net-weight, maximum-drag or retrieve-rate specification. These are front views only; unseen package backs were not verified.
Current launch release describes the spinning range but supplies none of the requested model-specific measurements.

search_coverage: Exact searches for all five model numbers, with and without the two official storefront domains excluded.
Exact SKU and UPC searches for all five models.
Model and family searches with weight, oz, drag, inches, retrieve rate and inches per turn; manufacturer catalog and PDF searches.
Official product comparisons and existing embedded-data extractions, all five package-front images, current launch release, and exact-model table in the official 2026 catalog.

excluded_evidence.candidate: Shopify product.variants[].weight in both official storefront extractions
excluded_evidence.reason: Commerce weight metadata is not explicitly identified as net reel weight and may represent shipping or packaged weight. Not converted into or accepted as weight_oz.

excluded_evidence.candidate: Older Tiger combo models, TS50A/TSP50A/TGRA50, TGRA40 spincast, and Tiger conventional-combo results
excluded_evidence.reason: Different model numbers, generations or reel types; no measurements transferred to TIGRSP30/40/50/60/80.

excluded_evidence.candidate: Line capacities, pre-spooled line strengths and gear ratios
excluded_evidence.reason: Line strength is not maximum drag, and gear ratio alone does not establish inches per handle turn. No estimates or inferred substitutions made.

recommended_disposition: Leave all 15 requested cells null pending an exact-model manufacturer specification sheet or written manufacturer confirmation of net reel weight, maximum drag and line recovery.
